info.title: Votrix Managed Agents
info.description:
Build and operate long-running agents through a durable, workspace-scoped REST API. This reference is generated from the same FastAPI application that serves production traffic, so request fields and response models stay aligned with the code.

> **Base URL** `https://managed-agents.votrixai.com`

Every `/v1` request requires the current `votrix-managed-agents-beta: votrix-managed-agents-2026-04-01` header plus either an `x-api-key` header or the same key as a Bearer token. Choose an endpoint to inspect its schema, copy a code sample, or send a request.

import os

import requests

payload = {'name': 'Research assistant',
 'model': {'id': 'gpt-5.5'},
 'system': 'Research the request and cite the sources you use.',
 'description': 'A research agent for customer questions.',
 'metadata': {'team': 'support'}}

response = requests.request(
    'POST',
    'https://managed-agents.votrixai.com/v1/agents',
    headers={
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'x-api-key': os.environ['VOTRIX_API_KEY'],
        'votrix-managed-agents-beta': 'votrix-managed-agents-2026-04-01',
    },
    json=payload,
)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json())
